rejected_detail.title: SerializeState: null Out pointer with sufficient capacity is unguarded
rejected_detail.reason: Contract-by-design: capacity-guarded raw-buffer serializer API (std::memcpy-equivalent); nullptr violates the documented precondition, every caller (both runners) passes stack arrays; guarding is not idiomatic and no reachable path exists.

severity_adjustments.finding: --probe --json-out with no value passes green with no artifact
severity_adjustments.reason: Manual-misuse only; local-ci gate 6 always passes the value; W6's artifact checks catch real write failures; compare-golden's missing-probe branch is a by-design fail-safe (committed golden still asserted engine-free + inline CHECKs).

severity_adjustments.finding: StateHash 64-byte fixed buffer silently degrades to constant hash past slice-1 growth
severity_adjustments.reason: Degradation fires the committed non-vacuity CHECKs in BOTH runners (hash stops changing on step) at the next gate run; defect is a latent confusing-failure-mode, not a silent wrong-result.

warnings.title: RngRange final addition can invoke signed-overflow UB for spans >= 2^31, violating the ODN-10 well-definedness its own header comment claims
warnings.evidence: return Lo + static_cast<int32_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(RngNext(R)) * Span) >> 32); — for Lo=INT32_MIN, Hi=INT32_MAX, Span=2^32 so offset==RngNext in [0,2^32-1]; int32 casts of values >INT32_MAX are implementation-defined (wrap negative), then Lo+negative underflows (UB). r1-N8 fixed the Hi-Lo subtraction; this is the remaining hole in the final add. Current tests only span [6,34]; no spine caller yet.
warnings.recommended_fix: Compute the result in int64: return (int32_t)((int64_t)Lo + (int64_t)((RngNext(R)*Span)>>32)); pin a full-span vector in both runners.

warnings.title: Format gate soft-skip false-greens: with no clang-format >= 14 on the machine, format-check.sh prints SKIP but exits 0, and local-ci's summary shows gate 1 as PASS
warnings.evidence: if [ -z "$FMT" ]; then echo "SKIP: no clang-format found ..."; exit 0; fi — gate runner marks exit 0 as '✅ PASS' in the summary. Narrower than r1-B2 (this machine/CI hosts have clang-format) but the same false-green class on bare hosts.
warnings.recommended_fix: Exit 3 on missing tool and have the gate runner treat 3 as loud SKIP (summary line SKIP, not PASS), or fail the gate outright outside --fast.
